blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Interior Secretary Juanito Victor “Jonvic” Remulla warned about the criminal group True Brown Style (TBS), recruiting minors through robbery initiations, assuring that authorities are gathering intelligence on its members and will “get them.” “Now this has become too much. We are holding command conferences with all the police, and we are gathering intelligence on who their members are, and we will get them,” said Remulla in an ambush interview after a turnover ceremony in Pampanga on Wednesday. “Now, as part of their recruitment, before you can join the group, you have to rob a convenience store at gunpoint,” Remulla […]...
